label: House of the Dragons
rubric: Size & power · Rider bond · Battle record · Legend status

entries.name: Vhagar
entries.rationale: The largest living dragon in Westeros, a two-century-old veteran of Aegon's Conquest.

entries.name: Sunfyre
entries.rationale: Called the most beautiful dragon ever to fly, and one of the deadliest despite crippling injuries.

entries.name: Caraxes
entries.rationale: The 'Blood Wyrm,' Daemon Targaryen's fierce, blood-red mount and a war veteran many times over.

entries.name: Vermithor
entries.rationale: The 'Bronze Fury,' second only to Vhagar in size, once ridden by Old King Jaehaerys himself.

entries.name: Meleys
entries.rationale: The 'Red Queen,' among the fastest dragons alive, ridden by Rhaenys into her final, legendary stand.

entries.name: Cannibal
entries.rationale: A wild, unridden dragon of monstrous size and appetite, feared even by other dragons.

entries.name: Syrax
entries.rationale: Rhaenyra Targaryen's golden dragon, symbol of her claim to the Iron Throne.

entries.name: Seasmoke
entries.rationale: A striking silver-and-white dragon bonded first to Laenor Velaryon, then to Addam of Hull.

entries.name: Sheepstealer
entries.rationale: A feral, ill-tempered wild dragon eventually tamed by the fearless dragonseed Nettles.

entries.name: Dreamfyre
entries.rationale: One of the oldest dragons of the era, bonded to the gentle, prophetic Helaena Targaryen.

entries.name: Vermax
entries.rationale: Jacaerys Velaryon's swift dragon, put to critical use rallying the north for Rhaenyra's cause.

entries.name: Silverwing
entries.rationale: Once flown by Good Queen Alysanne, later ridden into war by Ulf the White.

entries.name: Tessarion
entries.rationale: The 'Blue Queen,' a small but brilliantly colored dragon bonded to Daeron Targaryen.

entries.name: Moondancer
entries.rationale: A small, agile dragon whose young rider Baela Targaryen fought fiercely above her weight class.

entries.name: Arrax
entries.rationale: Lucerys Velaryon's dragon, whose fatal clash with Vhagar over Shipbreaker Bay ignited the war.

entries.name: Tyraxes
entries.rationale: A young dragon bonded to Joffrey Velaryon, barely grown by the time the Dance began.

entries.name: Morning
entries.rationale: Hobert Hightower's dragon, one of several smaller mounts pressed into the war's chaos.

entries.name: Shrykos
entries.rationale: A small dragon claimed by young Aegon the Younger, killed before it could ever truly grow.

entries.name: Stormcloud
entries.rationale: The dragon of young Joffrey Velaryon's half-brother, lost tragically before adulthood.

entries.name: Grey Ghost
entries.rationale: An elusive pale-grey wild dragon of the Vale, rarely seen and never successfully tamed.
